name: Pricing Block
description: Pricing cards with tiers, feature lists, and highlighted plan.

props.name: tiers
props.description: Required. Plan cards: name, price, description, features and optional highlighted flag and ctaText. Example: tiers={[{ name: "Pro", price: "$29", description: "For teams", features: ["SSO"] }]}

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading above the plan grid. Example: title="Plans"

props.name: subtitle
props.default: Choose a plan that works for you
props.description: Supporting line under the heading. Example: subtitle="Cancel anytime"

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the section wrapper. Example: className="bg-muted/20"
